```yaml
name: Trigger Flaky Tests
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'src/plugins/fleet/**'
      - 'src/core/**'
      - 'x-pack/plugins/fleet/**'
      - 'packages/kbn-ui-shared-deps/**'
      - 'packages/kbn-ui-framework/**'
      - '.github/workflows/trigger-flaky.yml'

jobs:
  trigger-flaky-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed-files
        uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          filter: 'src/plugins/fleet|src/core|x-pack/plugins/fleet|packages/kbn-ui-shared-deps|packages/kbn-ui-framework'

      - name: Setup Node.js and install dependencies
        uses: MetaMask/action-checkout-and-setup@v3
        with:
          is-high-risk-environment: false
          node-version: '22.17.1'
          cache-node-modules: true
          yarn-install-max-retries: 3

      - name: Run unit tests for affected components
        if: steps.changed-files.outputs.modified || steps.changed-files.outputs.added
        run: |
          yarn test:jest --testPathPattern="src/plugins/fleet|src/core|x-pack/plugins/fleet|packages/kbn-ui-shared-deps|packages/kbn-ui-framework" --passWithNoTests --verbose

      - name: Run flaky test suite
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "Running flaky tests to verify fix for disabled upload button during custom integration package installation"
          yarn test:jest --testPathPattern="src/plugins/fleet" --testNamePattern="Add to Elastic button is disabled during upload" --verbose
```
